bienvenida.texto: In one minute we show you how the Cajita de Bendición panel works. You can see this guide again anytime from the menu, under “User guide”.

menu.titulo: Everything is in the menu, by section
menu.texto: At the top, what you use on distribution day: Scan, Today and Register a person. Below, what you prepare beforehand, the numbers and administration. On a phone, tap the button at the top to open it; on a computer it’s on the side. This guide is always at the end of the menu, under “User guide”, on any phone.

escanear.texto: Put the person's QR inside the frame. If everything is right, it is delivered on its own: a green “Let them through” appears with their name, and the camera is ready for the next car. No button to tap.

colores.texto: Green: let them through, give them their box. Red: they already received today, do not give another. Orange: it is for another date or another line; read what the screen says before delivering.

deshacer.texto: Tap “Undo this delivery” during the first minute and that code works again. After a minute, ask an administrator.

buscar.titulo: If the QR will not scan
buscar.texto: In the car line, tap “Search by name or code”: you see today's people right there. Type part of the name (even if you're not sure how it's spelled: “Javier” also finds “Xavier”) or their code, tap the person and then “Record delivery”. In the walk-up line, under the camera type the number or the digits of their code: results show up as you type. Tap the number to give out, or the “i” to see its details.

sinCita.titulo: If someone arrives without an appointment
sinCita.texto: Write down their name and, if they give it, their phone. Give them the receipt code (SC-…) shown on screen, in case something needs to be cleared up later.

citasHoy.texto: How many have come, how many are left, and the list for the day. “View” opens a person's record. The administrator also sees their QR there and can mark as delivered a box that was not recorded.

registrar.texto: For someone who can’t sign up on their own, like an older adult without a phone: you give them an appointment for a date. Permanent passes are given in “Passes”.

horarios.texto: Here you create delivery dates, their time slots and how many fit in each. If the truck is late or a day must be moved or cancelled, use “There is a problem this day”.

reportes.texto: When you open it you see the last distribution day, with cars and walk-up separately. Also by week, month, year or between two dates: what is reported to the food bank.

avisos.texto: What people read, grouped by when they read it: what they see first, the rules before signing up, and information. Each one says where it appears, and you can see it as people do.

equipo.texto: In “Team & access” you give someone access with their Google email. In “Permissions” you choose, with checkmarks, what else each volunteer can do.

listo.texto: That is all. If you have a question, open this guide from the menu, under “User guide”. Thank you for serving!

elegirFila.titulo: First, your line for the day
elegirFila.texto: When you open the scanner, choose whether you are in the car line or the walk-up line today. You will only hand out codes from that line. If you are moved, tap «Change line» and confirm.

dosQr.titulo: Each line has its own QR
dosQr.texto: The car code has a blue car in the middle; the walk-up code, an orange walking person. That way you know which line it belongs to before scanning.

turnos.texto: Above the camera you see the current number and the next ones. Scan their QR; if they don't have it but know their number, tap “Give out without QR”. If they're not here, tap “Did not show up”: the line moves on. If they arrive within a few minutes, give it out; if they took long, the scanner asks you and you tap “Void number”: they'll need a new one. For someone without a phone, use “Give a new number” in the panel. When you're done, tap “End today's line”.

filaAPie.texto: When you create a date, choose whether it’s cars only, walk-up only or both. For the walk-up line you set the start time and how many numbers (or no limit); numbers open an hour before. If you turn on “Ask for today’s code”, people must type 4 digits that you post at the entrance to get a number. Right there you can download the poster with the QR.

personas.texto: Find someone by name, phone or CB code, even if they registered several times. From there you give them a pass or make them VIP.

pases.texto: When giving a pass, first say whether the person already has a CB code. If not, you register them right there. The pass works in the car line and the walk-up line, and you can mark it as VIP.

voluntarios.texto: Each volunteer has a badge with a green QR. When they arrive and when they leave, scan it in «Volunteers»: the first scan is their check-in and the second their check-out. Their hours are there too.

nunca.ayuda: Not even with a checkbox. These belong to the administrator and stay that way.

equipo.porque: That is where roles are handed out. A volunteer who could get in would make themselves an administrator, and then this list would mean nothing.

horarios.porque: Opening or deleting a date moves the whole community's capacity, not one person's.

excepciones.porque: It is the exception to the one box per week rule, and by definition the pastor authorizes it.

pregunta.vip: Give {{nombre}} ({{codigo}}) a VIP pass? Their QR is gold and they go straight in, no line.
pregunta.pase: Give {{nombre}} ({{codigo}}) a permanent pass? It works Mondays and Thursdays, one box per day.
pregunta.quitarVip: Remove VIP from {{nombre}} ({{codigo}})? Their pass still works, but they wait in line like everyone.

listo.pase: Done: {{nombre}} ({{codigo}}) now has a permanent pass.

ventanaPase.cuidado: This link opens their pass: send it only to that person. If you think someone else has it, tap “New code” in Passes and the old one stops working.

demo.aviso: Video example: nothing you do here is saved and the code you get will not work.

invitar.quienes: People who came without an appointment on {{fecha}}
invitar.comoFunciona: One at a time: tap “Open WhatsApp”, send the message, come back here and tap “I sent it”. You can close this and continue later: it remembers who you already messaged. If someone replies “NO”, do not message them again.
invitar.repetidos_one: {{count}} shares a phone with someone else (they get one message)
invitar.repetidos_other: {{count}} share a phone with someone else (they get one message)
invitar.nadie: Nobody that day left a phone number.
invitar.terminoConSaltados_one: You reached the end. {{count}} is left: see “See everyone”.
invitar.terminoConSaltados_other: You reached the end. {{count}} are left: see “See everyone”.

turnoAPie.subtitulo: Get your number here. You do not need to give any information.
turnoAPie.noHay: There is no walk-up line today.
turnoAPie.llena: There are no more numbers today.
turnoAPie.acercate: Come up and show your QR code.

avisos.sinDatos: We do not ask for your name, age or phone number. None of this is saved or shared.
avisos.soloHoy: Your number is for today only and for one box.
avisos.abierta: Keep this page open: you can see which number is being served, and your phone rings when you are 3 away and when it is your turn.
avisos.teLlaman: If your number is called and you're not here, come over as soon as you can. If you take too long, your number is voided and you'll need to get a new one, at the end of the line.
avisos.cadaQuien: Each adult gets their own number. If you do not have a phone, ask a volunteer.

carro.titulo: You already have a car appointment today at {{hora}}.
carro.texto_one: If you switch to walking, your car appointment is cancelled and you cannot go back to the car line.
carro.texto_other: If you switch to walking, your car appointments for today are cancelled and you cannot go back to the car line.
carro.no: No, I will stay in the car
carro.duenio_one: You are the car's owner: the appointment of your {{count}} passenger is cancelled too. They will need to get their own number (with their phone, or by asking a volunteer).
carro.duenio_other: You are the car's owner: your {{count}} passengers' appointments are cancelled too. Each one will need to get their own number (with their phone, or by asking a volunteer).
carro.seguro: Are you sure you want to switch to walking?
carro.siTodos: Yes, cancel the car and switch to walking

resultado.YA_RECIBIO_EN_CARRO: You already received your box by car today. Thank you for coming!
resultado.NO_HAY_FILA: There is no walk-up line today.
resultado.CERRADA: No more numbers are being given today.
resultado.TURNOS_ANULADOS: Two of your numbers were already voided today because you weren't here when they were called. If you need help, talk to a volunteer.

errores.SIN_CONEXION: No connection. Check your signal and tap the button again.
errores.FUNCION_NO_INSTALADA: This option is not ready yet. Please tell a volunteer.
errores.DISPOSITIVO_INVALIDO: We could not give you a number from this phone. Please ask a volunteer.
errores.ERROR_DESCONOCIDO: We could not give you a number. Tap the button again or ask a volunteer.

turnoAPie.terminada: Today's line is over. Thank you for coming! We hope to see you at the next distribution.
turnoAPie.codigoEsTuyo: This code is yours alone: don't show it to anyone. It proves the number is yours.

codigo.ayuda: It's 4 numbers, written at the entrance. If you can't see it, ask a volunteer.
codigo.FALTA_CODIGO: Type today's code to get your number.
codigo.CODIGO_INCORRECTO: That isn't today's code. Check it and try again.
codigo.DEMASIADOS_INTENTOS: Too many tries. You can try again in {{reloj}}.

turnoAPie.anotalo: Write down your number ({{turno}}) or take a photo of this screen. If the page closes, don't get another number: tell the volunteer your number.
turnoAPie.yaTenias: Already got your number and the page closed? Don't get another one: tell the volunteer your number.

carroCodigo.abrir: Did you have a car appointment today?
carroCodigo.ayuda: If the car line is very long, you can switch to the walk-up line. Type the code of your car appointment. Your car appointment is cancelled and you can't go back to the car line.
carroCodigo.campoAyuda: Just the digits (4 or 5): “CB-” is already there.
carroCodigo.cancelar: I didn't have a car appointment
carroCodigo.CODIGO_CARRO_NO_EXISTE: We couldn't find a car appointment for today with that code. Check the digits.

codigoDelDia.ayuda: To get a number, people must type 4 digits that are only shown at the entrance (on the board, or said by the volunteer). This way nobody gets a number from home. Numbers given by the volunteer don't need it.
codigoDelDia.error: The code couldn't be changed. Try again.

cartel.ayuda: The QR to get a number, ready to print, with a box to write that day's code.
cartel.error: The poster couldn't be prepared. Try again.
cartel.mensaje: Scan here to get your number

hasta.titulo: Until what time is the code required?
hasta.hora: Time when the code stops being required
hasta.ayuda: After that time it is no longer required: anyone can get a number with the QR on the sign, and they go to the end of the line.
hasta.antesDeAbrir: At that time numbers are not open yet: the code would never be required.

credencial.enseniala: Show it when you arrive and when you leave
credencial.comoFunciona: When you arrive, show this QR to an admin; when you leave, show it again. That is how your service hours are counted.
credencial.soloTuya: It is yours only: do not share it. If you lose it, ask for a new one.
credencial.cuidado: The link works like a key: send it only to that person (for example, by WhatsApp). If someone else got it, use «Change QR» and the old one stops working.
credencial.inactiva: This badge is no longer active.
credencial.inactivaTexto: If you think this is a mistake, call the church at {{telefono}}.
credencial.noEncontrada: We could not find this badge. Ask an admin to send you the link again.
credencial.sinConexion: Your badge could not load. Check your signal and open the link again.

horas.todavia: No complete visits yet. Once you are scanned when you arrive and when you leave, your hours will show here.
horas.ayuda: Only visits with check-in and check-out count. The last 10 are shown here.

voluntarios.ayuda: Volunteer check-in and check-out with their badge, and their service hours.

entrada.ayuda: If they have not checked in today, it checks them in; if they already did, it checks them out.
entrada.sinCredencial: No badge? Look them up by name
entrada.nadie: No active volunteer with that name. Register them in the «List» tab.

resultado.esCita: It looks like an appointment or pass QR: scan that one in «Scan».
resultado.noEsCredencial: That QR is not a volunteer's badge.
resultado.inactivoAyuda: Their badge does not check in. If they will serve again, reactivate them in the «List» tab.
resultado.olvido: On {{dia}} they left without checking out: fix it in the «Hours» tab.

deshecho.SALIDA_DESHECHA: Done, they are still in: that check-out was removed.

registrar.ayuda: No account needed: with their name they get a badge with a QR to keep on their phone or print.
registrar.contactoAyuda: Their phone (to send their badge by WhatsApp), their email, or both separated by a comma.

avisos.registrado: Done, they are registered. Send them their badge or save it to print.
avisos.baja: Done, deactivated. Their badge no longer checks in.
avisos.nuevoQr: Done, they have a new badge. The old one no longer works: send them the new one.

lista.vacia: No volunteers yet. Register the first one above.

preguntar.baja: Deactivate {{nombre}}? Their badge stops checking in. Their hours are kept.
preguntar.qr: Change {{nombre}}'s QR? Their current badge stops working and you need to send them the new one.

lista.faltan_one: {{count}} volunteer does not have their badge.
lista.faltan_other: {{count}} volunteers do not have their badge.
lista.nadieAsi: Nobody in that list. Try another filter or clear the search.
lista.contactoViejo: Contact to fix: «{{contacto}}». Tap Edit to fix it.

horas.ayuda: Only visits with check-in and check-out count. Tap a volunteer to see each day and fix it.
horas.motivoEjemplo: For example: left without checking out
horas.anularPregunta: Void this visit? It stops counting hours, but stays on record.
horas.agregarBoton: Came but was not scanned? Add a visit

errores.ERROR_DESCONOCIDO: It did not work. Try again.
errores.SIN_CONEXION: No signal. Check the internet and try again.
errores.FUNCION_NO_INSTALADA: This part is not ready in the system yet. Let the administrator know.
errores.CONTACTO_INVALIDO: The phone or email is too long.
errores.FUERA_DE_PLAZO: The 2 minutes to undo are over. Fix it in the «Hours» tab.
errores.HORAS_INVALIDAS: Check the times: check-out goes after check-in, and no more than 16 hours.
errores.HORA_FUTURA: Check-out cannot be a time that has not come yet.
errores.TRASLAPE: Those times overlap another visit of that person.
errores.RANGO_INVALIDO: Check the dates: «From» goes before «To», and no more than a year.
errores.TELEFONO_INVALIDO: That phone is not complete: it needs 10 digits (with +52 in front if it is from Mexico).
errores.CORREO_INVALIDO: That email is not complete: check what comes after the @.
errores.MEDIO_INVALIDO: The sending could not be recorded. Try again.

envio.noEnviada: It has not been sent yet.
envio.sinContacto: No phone or email: save the image or print it and give it in person.
envio.asunto: Your volunteer badge · Cajita de Bendición
envio.correoWeb: Email app not opening? Open it in the browser, already written:

cierre.ayuda: Anyone who checked in after that time stays in.
cierre.ninguno: Nobody had checked in before that time: no one was checked out.

constancia.ayuda: Only the sheet prints. To get a PDF, choose «Save as PDF» in the print window.
constancia.sirvio: served as a volunteer in the {{programa}} program at {{iglesia}} between {{desde}} and {{hasta}}, for a total of
constancia.expedida: Issued at the request of the volunteer on {{fecha}}.

imprimirCredenciales.ayuda: 8 fit on a letter sheet: cut along the dotted line. These are the ones shown in the list; for others, go back and choose another filter.
imprimirCredenciales.marcarEntregadas: I handed them out on paper
imprimirCredenciales.entregadas_one: Done: {{count}} was recorded as handed out on paper.
imprimirCredenciales.entregadas_other: Done: {{count}} were recorded as handed out on paper.
imprimirCredenciales.ninguna: No badges to print with that filter.

preferente.voluntario: Skips the line. Check it is the right person before handing out.
preferente.persona: You skip the line: show this QR to a volunteer.

filaEnVivo.subtitulo: See how the line is moving. You do not need a number.
filaEnVivo.noHay: There is no walk-in line today.
filaEnVivo.porAbrir: It has not started yet: numbers open at {{hora}}.
filaEnVivo.terminada_one: Today's line has ended: {{count}} person received their groceries. Thank you!
filaEnVivo.terminada_other: Today's line has ended: {{count}} people received their groceries. Thank you!
filaEnVivo.noEsTuyo: These numbers belong to other people, not to you.
filaEnVivo.yaNoSeDan: No new numbers are being given today.
filaEnVivo.sinSenal: No signal: this is the latest we know. It will update when the connection is back.
